subject: Risk & Compliance
title: IoT Security Risks
description: Learn IoT Security Risks in one minute.

hook.text: Your smart thermostat, security camera, and fridge are all on the internet. None of them get security updates.

buildup.text: By 2025, over 75 billion IoT devices are connected globally. Most ship with default passwords.

discovery.text: The Mirai botnet turned thousands of IoT cameras into a weapon that took down Twitter, Netflix, and Reddit.

twist.text: IoT manufacturers have no incentive to invest in security. Cheap devices with long lifespans never get patched.

climax.text: Every unsecured device is a potential soldier in the next botnet army. The attack surface grows daily.

punchline.text: 75 billion devices. Default passwords. Growing army.

quiz.question: What did the Mirai botnet use to launch its attack?
